这曲子蛮好听的，自己翻了一版，没原版那么少女，但或许更贴近CEL？我其实觉得原版歌词也挺贴合CEL的。

const audio = document.getElementById('audio');
const lyricsWrap = document.getElementById('lyricsWrap');
const progressFill = document.getElementById('progressFill');
const timeDisplay = document.getElementById('timeDisplay');
const playIcon = document.getElementById('playIcon');

const playPath = "M8 5v14l11-7z";
const pausePath = "M6 19h4V5H6v14zm8-14v14h4V5h-4z";

// Build lyric DOM
lyrics.forEach((line, i) => {
  const block = document.createElement('div');
  block.className = 'lyric-block';
  block.id = `line-${i}`;
  block.innerHTML = `<div class="lyric-jp">${line.jp}</div><div class="lyric-zh">${line.zh}</div>`;
  block.onclick = () => { audio.currentTime = line.t; audio.play(); };
  lyricsWrap.appendChild(block);
});

function fmt(s) {
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const sec = Math.floor(s % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  return `${m}:${sec}`;
}

let currentLine = -1;

audio.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
  const t = audio.currentTime;
  const dur = audio.duration || 0;

  // Progress
  progressFill.style.width = dur ? `${(t / dur) * 100}%` : '0%';
  timeDisplay.textContent = `${fmt(t)} / ${fmt(dur)}`;

  // Active line
  let active = -1;
  for (let i = lyrics.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (t >= lyrics[i].t) { active = i; break; }
  }

  if (active !== currentLine) {
    if (currentLine >= 0) document.getElementById(`line-${currentLine}`)?.classList.remove('active');
    if (active >= 0) {
      const el = document.getElementById(`line-${active}`);
      el?.classList.add('active');
      el?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    }
    currentLine = active;
  }
});

function togglePlay() {
  if (audio.paused) {
    audio.play();
    playIcon.setAttribute('d', pausePath);
  } else {
    audio.pause();
    playIcon.setAttribute('d', playPath);
  }
}

audio.addEventListener('ended', () => {
  playIcon.setAttribute('d', playPath);
});

function seek(e) {
  const bar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
  const rect = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
  const ratio = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
  audio.currentTime = ratio * (audio.duration || 0);
}
</script>
